Per-peptide quality checks of the input data

Source: R/peptide_qc.R
peptide_qc.Rd

Lists, for every peptide (start, end, sequence, charge) in every protein state, simple checks of the controls and uptake values. Nothing is removed from the data; use the table to decide what to exclude.

Usage

peptide_qc(filepath)

Arguments

filepath

input file or table, as for output_tp().

Value

data frame with one row per state and peptide.

Details

Checks:

has_undeut

an undeuterated ("0s") control is present. Without it HDXExaminer cannot compute uptake and reports 0.

all_zero_uptake

uptake is exactly 0 at every labeling time and in the FD control - in practice a missing reference, not a real measurement of no exchange.

negative_uptake

at least one replicate has uptake below 0.

fd_uptake

mean uptake (Da) of the fully deuterated ("FD") control, NA if there is none.

max_uptake

theoretical maximum: length - 1 - prolines after the first residue (as HDXExaminer and DynamX count it).

fd_fraction

fd_uptake / max_uptake; 1 minus this is the peptide's back-exchange (without correction for the D2O fraction).

fd_missing, fd_nonpositive, fd_above_max

no FD value; FD uptake <= 0; FD uptake above the theoretical maximum.

issues

the checks that failed, as text (empty if none).

Examples

file_nm <- system.file("extdata", "All_results_table.csv", package = "HDXBoxeR")
qc <- peptide_qc(file_nm)
qc[qc$issues != "", ]
#>    Protein.State Start End     Sequence Charge has_undeut all_zero_uptake
#> 30       Unbound   182 193 IWNKTASDQATT      2      FALSE            TRUE
#> 64         bound   182 193 IWNKTASDQATT      2      FALSE            TRUE
#>    negative_uptake fd_uptake max_uptake fd_fraction fd_missing fd_nonpositive
#> 30           FALSE         0         11           0      FALSE           TRUE
#> 64           FALSE         0         11           0      FALSE           TRUE
#>    fd_above_max                                                          issues
#> 30        FALSE no undeuterated control; uptake 0 at every time; FD uptake <= 0
#> 64        FALSE no undeuterated control; uptake 0 at every time; FD uptake <= 0
